message: Asked Claude to read the README and explain what to do.
Summarized the MP2 requirements and the setup and submission steps.
Asked what kind of app to build and for API recommendations.
Compared several APIs and recommended PokeAPI.
Asked whether the assignment requires an API key.
Explained that an API key is not required and PokeAPI needs none.
Chose PokeAPI and asked Claude to build the app.
Scaffolded the Vite React TypeScript project, installed react-router-dom, axios and normalize.css, and configured GitHub Pages.
code_excerpt:
base: '/mp2/',
"build": "tsc -b && vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html"

message: Wrote the Axios client. It fetches the first 151 Pokemon in batches of 30 and caches them in sessionStorage.
Added a React context so all pages share the loaded data, loading state and error state.
Set up routes with React Router.
code_excerpt:
<BrowserRouter basename={import.meta.env.BASE_URL}>
  <Route path="/" element={<ListView />} />
  <Route path="/gallery" element={<GalleryView />} />
  <Route path="/pokemon/:id" element={<DetailView />} />

message: Built the list view with search as you type and sorting by 5 properties in ascending or descending order.
Built the gallery view with multi-select type filters and an any/all match toggle.
Built the detail view. Previous and next cycle through the list the user came from and wrap around at the ends.
Added shared components and global styles. Stat bars use <meter> so there is no inline styling.
